title: Approve the right machine and identity
when: Connecting another computer or recovering an expired device code
need: Read the four-character terminal code before hosted organization selection. Select the intended organization, compare the machine, code and local expiry, and approve or deny personally. A code already routed elsewhere names its original organization and requires a fresh connection. Return to the terminal: pending waits until one-time delivery, denial or expiry. Lost delivery requires a fresh connection; expiry does not renew a code. A below-floor install names the operator rollout recovery.
surface: Shared approval card and machine authorization reference.
review: Engine producer contract and authorized consumer source evidence reviewed. Hosted source adoption is observed; exact redesign consumer integration, fresh installer approval and deployed personal-approval/one-time-delivery captures remain pending.
